# Sirach Chapter 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 27 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**27:1** Many have-sinned for-the-sake-of a-small-gain, and he-who-seeks-to-multiply [wealth] averts-his-eye.

**27:2** Like a-peg-driven between two-stones, so between-buying-and-selling sin will-wedge-itself.

**27:3** Unless a-man holds-fast in-the-fear of-the-LORD, his-house will-be-quickly-thrown-down.

**27:4** In-the-shaking of a-sieve the-dross-remains, so in-the-anxious-thought of a-man his-defect.

**27:5** The-furnace tests the-work of-the-potter, so the-test of a-man is in-his-reasoning.

**27:6** The-fruit of a-tree reveals its-cultivation, so the-word of a-man reveals the-thoughts of-his-heart.

**27:7** Before-you-hear, do-not-praise a-man; for this is-the-testing-of-persons.

**27:8** If you-pursue righteousness, you-will-attain it, and you-will-put-it-on like a-glorious-robe.

**27:9** Birds-of-a-kind come-to-rest with-their-kind, and truth returns to-those-who-practice it.

**27:10** The-lion lies-in-wait for its-prey; so sin for-those-who-practice lawlessness.

**27:11** The-discourse of a-devout-man is always-wisdom, but a-foolish-man changes like the-moon.

**27:12** Among men-without-understanding restrict your-time; but among thoughtful-men spend it continually.

**27:13** The-conversation of-fools is an-offense, and their-laughter is in-the-licentiousness of-sin.

**27:14** The-oath of a-man-of-frequent-swearing makes-hair-stand-on-end, and their-quarrel makes-one-stop-the-ears.

**27:15** The-blood-shedding of-those-who-quarrel with-each-other is-an-evil; and their-abuse becomes-hard-to-bear to-the-ear.

**27:16** Whoever-reveals secrets destroys faithfulness, and will-find-no-friend for-his-own-soul.

**27:17** Love your-friend and keep-faith with-him; but if-you-have-revealed his-secrets, do-not-pursue after-him.

**27:18** For as a-man destroyed his-enemy, so you-have-destroyed the-friendship of-your-neighbor.

**27:19** And as a-bird which-you-have-let-fly from your-hand, so you-have-let-go of your-friend and you-will-not-catch him.

**27:20** Do-not-pursue after-him, for he-is-far-gone; he-has-escaped like a-gazelle from a-snare; for his-soul is-wounded. There-is-no-more healing — for he-has-been-reviled and insulted.

**27:21** As-for silver and gold, a-disclosure will-establish them; but as-for you, you-have-been-found-out for your-neighbor's-words.

**27:22** A-man-who-winks-with-his-eye contrivingly, and who-will-escape-from-him?

**27:23** Before-your-face he-will-speak sweet-words and admire your-discourse, but afterwards he-will-twist his-mouth and will-speak-slander upon your-words.

**27:24** Many things I-have-hated, but nothing equal-to him; and the-LORD also will-hate him.

**27:25** Whoever-throws a-stone straight-up — upon his-own-head it-falls; and a-treacherous-blow will-wound treacherously.

**27:26** Whoever-digs a-pit — into it he-will-fall; and whoever-sets a-snare — in-it he-will-be-caught.

**27:27** Whoever-does-evil — upon him it-will-roll-back, and he-will-not-know-from-where it-came-upon him.

**27:28** Mockery and reproach are for-the-arrogant-man, and vengeance like a-lion will-lie-in-wait for-him.

**27:29** Those-who-rejoice in-the-fall of-the-devout will-be-caught in a-trap, and pain will-consume-them before-they-die.

**27:30** Wrath and anger — these-too are abominations, and a-sinful-man will-hold-them-fast.
